# MerchantPro

MerchantPro is an eCommerce platform for managing storefront catalogs, customers, orders, inventory, content, and related commerce operations.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/merchantpro/.

## Actions

- **Get Inventory Unit** (read-only): Return inventory and price information for one MerchantPro inventory unit.
- **Get Product** (read-only): Return details for one MerchantPro product, including variant IDs when the product has variants.
- **Get Shop Taxonomy** (read-only): Return the shop's currencies, languages, payment methods, or warehouses for interpreting catalog and order data.
- **List Catalog Partners** (read-only): List brands or suppliers used by the product catalog.
- **List Categories** (read-only): Find product categories by ID, name, parent, type, or status for catalog navigation and product filtering.
- **List Customer Subscriptions** (read-only): List recurring product subscriptions by customer, status, recurrence, type, or renewal date.
- **List Customers** (read-only): Find customers by identity, group, status, registration, newsletter, or location filters.
- **List Locations** (read-only): List countries, states, or cities for address and customer workflows.
- **List Orders** (read-only): Find shop orders by customer, payment, shipping, product, or modification filters without changing order state.
- **List Products** (read-only): Find products and variants in the shop catalog using common identity, category, brand, stock, visibility, and status filters.
